description: This source file defines the 'PipelineBySalesStageDashlet' class, which extends 'DashletGenericChart' to implement a custom dashboard widget for visualizing pipeline data by sales stage in a CRM system. It includes class properties, a constructor, methods for generating chart data, rendering options, and creating the chart for display within the CRM interface.

classes.name: PipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGenericChart to provide a customized chart dashlet for visualizing opportunities pipeline by sales stage with dynamic data fetching and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes default date range and title options for the dashlet, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates UI elements for configuring the dashlet's filters, especially sales stages.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data and generates the HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart visualization, including data fetching, chart configuration, and UI embedding.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by sales stage, reordered based on selected sales stages.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query string to retrieve opportunity count and total amount per sales stage within the selected date range.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Transforms raw database data into chart-ready data structure, including labels, data points, and total calculations.

methods.name: resizeLabel
methods.description: Truncates labels exceeding a specified length, appending an ellipsis for display.
